jobs.title: Global Managing Director, Lefay
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Global Managing Director – Lefay Wellness Resorts provides strategic and enterprise leadership for the long-term stewardship, evolution, and global expansion of Lefay, a luxury wellness resort brand. This role is accountable for safeguarding the brand’s founding philosophy and proprietary wellness methodologies while driving sustainable growth, financial performance, and asset value creation through a disciplined, asset-light model.

Operating within a Joint Venture structure, the Managing Director partners closely with the Founders, Joint Venture Board, and Marriott’s global and regional functions to ensure the brand’s standards, operating model, and development pipeline are scalable, compliant, and aligned across markets. The role requires strong governance, stakeholder alignment, and the ability to lead effectively within a complex, matrixed organization.

Leveraging a deliberately lean organizational model, the Managing Director provides leadership and strategic oversight across properties, including influence over General Manager selection and performance, while ensuring alignment to Lefay’s luxury positioning, wellness credibility, and guest experience standards.

The position reports to the JV Board.

Scope

• Location: Switzerland

• This position will be required to travel frequently

Key Responsibilities

• Protect and scale Lefay’s wellness philosophy and proprietary methodologies by codifying and embedding the brand’s integrated wellness framework, encompassing its scientific underpinnings, treatment methodologies, programme design, and translation into consistent guest experiences across diverse global markets.

• Partner with ownership and development teams to grow a disciplined global pipeline by identifying and evaluating target markets and opportunities, encompassing feasibility assessment, deal structuring support, and alignment of all new developments to Lefay’s brand positioning, design philosophy, and financial performance expectations.

• Drive alignment across Marriott, the Joint Venture Board, owners, and brand stakeholders by establishing and leading governance and decision-making frameworks, encompassing structured forums, clear roles and accountabilities, and consistent communication to enable prioritisation and execution within a complex matrixed environment.

• Oversee brand standards, guest experience, and wellness programming globally by defining and governing Lefay’s end-to-end brand framework, encompassing brand pillars and foundational elements, tone of voice and positioning, and the full guest journey from pre-arrival through post-stay engagement.

• Serve as the primary interface with the Joint Venture Board of Directors by leading strategic engagement and performance reporting, encompassing regular updates on financial performance, development pipeline progress, brand evolution, and alignment on long-term strategic priorities.

• Lead governance processes including strategy, budgeting, and reporting by establishing and maintaining enterprise planning and performance frameworks, encompassing annual and long-range strategic plans, budget and forecasting cycles, and disciplined reporting against agreed KPIs and investment objectives

• Embed compliance with Marriott policies and regulatory frameworks by integrating required standards and controls into the operating model, encompassing oversight across all properties and developments, adherence to legal and governance requirements, and proactive identification and mitigation of risk across jurisdictions.

• Own full P&L accountability including forecasting and capital planning by driving financial performance across the portfolio, encompassing revenue and profitability optimisation, budget development and reforecasting, and capital allocation decisions aligned to long-term asset value creation.

• Optimize a lean Joint Venture operating model by leveraging Marriott’s global and regional infrastructure, encompassing clear delineation of responsibilities across shared services, efficient resource allocation, and avoidance of unnecessary above-property duplication.

• Oversee design, technical standards, and sustainability integration by guiding concept development and execution across the portfolio, encompassing alignment to Lefay’s aesthetic and wellness positioning, technical and operational standards, and the integration of sustainability principles into both development and ongoing operations.

• Lead global stakeholder engagement with owners, developers, and partners by building and maintaining strategic relationships, encompassing alignment on brand expectations, performance outcomes, and long-term growth opportunities across the Lefay portfolio.

• Build and lead a high-performing leadership team across functions by defining required capabilities and structure, encompassing talent selection and development across brand, design, and finance, and embedding a culture aligned to Lefay’s values, standards, and performance expectations.

• Lead through influence within a complex matrix organisation by aligning cross-functional Marriott teams across regions and disciplines, encompassing collaboration, prioritisation, and delivery of shared objectives without direct line authority.

• Sustain strong relationships to drive long-term brand and financial performance by engaging consistently with owners, Joint Venture partners, and internal stakeholders, encompassing alignment to strategic priorities, investment objectives, and sustained brand integrity over time.

Additional Duties

• Uphold the highest standards of business ethics and compliance with Marriott policies.

• Champion cross-functional collaboration and team excellence, building a purpose-driven, peak performance culture across EMEA hotels and offices.
 Candidate Profile

Required

• 15+ years of senior leadership experience within upper‑luxury hospitality, lifestyle, or wellness‑adjacent brands, ideally in resort environments.

• Demonstrated credibility in the wellness space, paired with the judgment to operate as an enterprise business leader rather than a functional specialist.

• Proven success leading complex, multi‑entity or Joint Venture structures with Board‑level accountability.

• Extensive experience operating in multicultural, matrixed, and internationally regulated environments, including Europe.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate market and business trends and translate strategy into large‑scale execution

• College degree required

Preferred

• Demonstrated strong strategic and commercial leadership, balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and bringing deep financial acumen across P&L ownership, budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning.

• Operated effectively within complex, matrixed and Joint Venture environments, influencing outcomes without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders including Boards, owners, partners, and cross-functional teams.

• Exhibited credible and influential leadership, combining entrepreneurial brand stewardship with enterprise-level governance, supported by sound judgment, strong negotiation capability, and fact-based decision making.

• Built, led, and developed high-performing teams within lean organisational models, demonstrating the ability to prioritise, problem-solve, and deliver results in fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous environments.

• Demonstrated strong governance, risk, and compliance capability, operating with high integrity and accountability across multi-jurisdictional environments and leading transformation while maintaining operational stability.

• Built trusted relationships and aligned stakeholders globally, combining exceptional communication and partnership capability with a global mindset and a purpose-driven leadership style aligned to wellness values, resilience, and personal accountability.

• Graduate degree preferred, such as MBA or equivalent

Key Competencies

• Curious : Open to new ideas, seeks diverse viewpoints, and explores better ways of working.

• Courageous : Challenges norms, takes ownership, and leads change.

• Connected : Builds meaningful relationships and fosters collaboration across boundaries.

Enterprise Leadership & Peak Performance Capabilities

• Demonstrates strong commercial judgement and financial acumen, applying insight to drive sustainable results and enterprise value across a complex, multi brand and multimarket environment.

• Operates effectively in ambiguity, complexity, and change, maintaining clarity of direction and momentum while balancing competing priorities, commitments, and decision horizons.

• Thinks and acts with an enterprise mindset, prioritising end to end outcomes over functional or local optimisation and making disciplined trade-offs that protect brand integrity—particularly within luxury—while optimising enterprise value.

• Sets clear strategic direction and translates vision into priorities, commitments, and measurable outcomes through others, across a highly matrixed and geographically dispersed organisation.

• Builds strong, trust based stakeholder partnerships across senior regional leaders, owners and franchise partners, hotel leadership, brand and luxury platforms, and discipline teams; influences without authority and aligns diverse and sometimes competing interests toward shared enterprise outcomes.

• Leads inclusively across diverse cultures, geographies, and perspectives, demonstrating strong cultural fluency and situational awareness while reinforcing common purpose, values, and standards.

• Creates the conditions for sustained high performance, holding high standards of accountability while enabling focus, alignment, and continuous improvement at scale.

Leadership Approach & Expectations

• Leads through vision and values, ensuring decisions and behaviours consistently reflect organisational purpose, brand standards, and enterprise leadership expectations.

• Leads as a coach, adopting a coaching mindset that builds capability, strengthens judgement, and multiplies impact across teams, markets, and stakeholder groups.

• Embeds continuous, real time coaching and feedback, supporting individuals and teams to adapt, learn, and perform at their best in complex and evolving environments.

• Drives and sustains change, modelling resilience, composure, and confidence while removing barriers and accelerating progress across multiple geographies and stakeholder systems.

• Applies sound judgement and enterprise level decision making, integrating multiple perspectives, data, and contextual insight to navigate complexity and make effective trade-offs.

• Delivers results through others, setting clear expectations, establishing individual and collective accountability, and ensuring follow through across a matrixed operating model.

• Invests actively in talent and succession, developing current and future leaders capable of operating at scale and representing the enterprise across brands and markets.

Contribution to Peak Performance

• Champions a coaching led performance culture, where trust, learning, and honest dialogue enable sustained performance across diverse teams, brands, and geographies.

• Connects individual and team contributions to enterprise priorities and outcomes, reinforcing ownership, accountability, and clarity of purpose in a complex operating environment.

• Strengthens organisational capability by scaling impact through people, enabling leaders and teams to perform effectively without reliance on personal heroics.

• Shapes a culture of continuous improvement, resilience, and disciplined execution, ensuring the enterprise delivers consistent results while protecting brand integrity—particularly within luxury—and meeting commitments across markets.

Marriott International is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi del lavoro Il Global Managing Director – Lefay Wellness Resorts fornisce una leadership strategica e aziendale per la gestione a lungo termine, l'evoluzione e l'espansione globale di Lefay, un marchio di resort di lusso. Questo ruolo è responsabile per la salvaguardia della filosofia fondatrice del marchio e delle metodologie di benessere proprietarie, mentre guida la crescita sostenibile, le prestazioni finanziarie e la creazione di valore patrimoniale attraverso un modello disciplinato, asset-light. Operando all'interno di una struttura Joint Venture, l'Amministratore Delegato collabora strettamente con i Fondatori, Joint Venture Board e le funzioni globali e regionali di Marriott per garantire gli standard del marchio, modello operativo e pipeline di sviluppo sono scalabili, conformi e allineati su mercati. Il ruolo richiede una forte governance, allineamento delle parti interessate e la capacità di condurre efficacemente all'interno di un'organizzazione complessa e matrice. Sfruttando un modello organizzativo deliberatamente magra, l’Amministratore Delegato fornisce leadership e supervisione strategica tra le proprietà, tra cui l’influenza sulla selezione e le prestazioni di General Manager, garantendo al contempo l’allineamento agli standard di lusso di Lefay, la credibilità del benessere e l’esperienza degli ospiti. La posizione riporta alla JV Board. Ambito
• Ubicazione: Svizzera
• Questa posizione sarà richiesta per viaggiare frequentemente
• Relazioni dirette: TBD Principali responsabilità
• Proteggere e scalare la filosofia di benessere di Lefay e le metodologie proprietarie codificando e incorporando il quadro di benessere integrato del marchio, comprendendo i suoi sottopinnings scientifici, metodologie di trattamento, progettazione di programmi e traduzione in esperienze ospiti coerenti in diversi mercati globali.
• Partner con i team di proprietà e sviluppo per crescere una pipeline globale disciplinata individuando e valutando i mercati e le opportunità di destinazione, comprendendo la valutazione della fattibilità, il supporto di strutturazione degli accordi e l'allineamento di tutti i nuovi sviluppi al posizionamento del marchio Lefay, la filosofia del design e le aspettative di performance finanziarie.
• Allineare l'unità attraverso Marriott, il Joint Venture Board, i proprietari e le parti interessate del marchio, stabilendo e conducendo quadri di governance e decision-making, comprendendo forum strutturati, ruoli chiari e responsabilità, e una comunicazione coerente per consentire la priorità e l'esecuzione all'interno di un ambiente matrice complesso.
• Superare gli standard di marca, l'esperienza degli ospiti e la programmazione del benessere a livello globale definendo e governando il framework end-to-end di Lefay, che comprende pilastri di marca e elementi fondamentali, tono di voce e posizionamento, e il viaggio ospiti completo dal pre-arrivo attraverso l'impegno post-stay.
• Serve come interfaccia primaria con il Consiglio di Amministrazione Joint Venture con il principale impegno strategico e la segnalazione delle prestazioni, comprendendo aggiornamenti regolari sulle prestazioni finanziarie, il progresso delle pipeline di sviluppo, l'evoluzione del marchio e l'allineamento sulle priorità strategiche a lungo termine.
• Processi di governance di piombo, tra cui strategia, budgeting e reporting, stabilendo e mantenendo i quadri di pianificazione e di performance delle imprese, comprendendo piani strategici annuali e a lungo termine, cicli di bilancio e di previsione, e la relazione disciplinata contro i KPI concordati e obiettivi di investimento
• Integrare le norme e i controlli richiesti nel modello operativo, comprendendo la supervisione di tutte le proprietà e gli sviluppi, l'adesione ai requisiti legali e di governance e l'identificazione proattiva e la mitigazione del rischio attraverso le giurisdizioni.
• L'intera responsabilità P&L include la previsione e la pianificazione del capitale, guidando le prestazioni finanziarie in tutto il portafoglio, comprendendo l'ottimizzazione dei ricavi e della redditività, lo sviluppo del bilancio e il riforecasting, e le decisioni di allocazione del capitale allineate alla creazione di valore patrimoniale a lungo termine.
• Ottimizzare un modello operativo Joint Venture lean sfruttando l’infrastruttura globale e regionale di Marriott, comprendendo una chiara delineazione delle responsabilità nei servizi condivisi, l’efficiente allocazione delle risorse e l’elusione di una duplicazione non necessaria al di sopra della prosperità.
• Superare il design, gli standard tecnici e l’integrazione della sostenibilità guidando lo sviluppo e l’esecuzione del concetto in tutto il portafoglio, comprendendo l’allineamento al posizionamento estetico e benessere di Lefay, agli standard tecnici e operativi e all’integrazione dei principi di sostenibilità sia nello sviluppo che nelle operazioni in corso.
• Leader globale impegno degli stakeholder con i proprietari, gli sviluppatori e i partner attraverso la costruzione e il mantenimento di relazioni strategiche, che comprendono l'allineamento sulle aspettative del marchio, i risultati delle prestazioni e le opportunità di crescita a lungo termine nel portafoglio Lefay.
• Costruire e guidare un team di leadership altamente performante attraverso le funzioni definendo le capacità e la struttura necessarie, comprendendo la selezione e lo sviluppo di talenti tra brand, design e finanza, e incorporando una cultura allineata ai valori, agli standard e alle aspettative delle prestazioni di Lefay.
• Guidare attraverso l'influenza all'interno di un'organizzazione di matrice complessa allineando i team di Marriott multifunzionali in tutte le regioni e discipline, comprendendo la collaborazione, la priorità e la consegna di obiettivi condivisi senza l'autorità di linea diretta.
• Sostenere relazioni forti per guidare il marchio a lungo termine e le prestazioni finanziarie, impegnando costantemente con i proprietari, i partner Joint Venture e le parti interessate interne, che comprendono l'allineamento alle priorità strategiche, obiettivi di investimento, e l'integrità del marchio sostenuta nel tempo. Ulteriori diritti
• Mantenere i più elevati standard di etica aziendale e il rispetto delle politiche Marriott.
• Collaborazione trasversale e eccellenza del team, la costruzione di una cultura mirata e di alte prestazioni in hotel e uffici EMEA. Profilo del candidato Obbligo
• 15+ anni di esperienza di leadership senior all'interno dell'ospitalità di lusso superiore, dello stile di vita, o del benessere-agjacent marche, idealmente in ambienti resort.
• Dimostrata credibilità nello spazio benessere, abbinato al giudizio di operare come leader aziendale piuttosto che come specialista funzionale.
• Prove strutture complesse, multi-entity o Joint Venture con responsabilità a livello di Consiglio.
• Esperienza estesa che opera in ambienti multiculturali, matrici e regolamentati a livello internazionale, tra cui l'Europa.
• Capacità dimostrata di valutare le tendenze del mercato e del business e di tradurre la strategia in esecuzione su larga scala
• Grado universitario richiesto Preferito
• Dimostrato una forte leadership strategica e commerciale, bilanciando la visione a lungo termine con l'esecuzione disciplinata e portando un profondo acume finanziario tra la proprietà P&L, il budgeting, la previsione e la pianificazione del capitale.
• Operato efficacemente all'interno di ambienti complessi, matrici e Joint Venture, influenzando i risultati senza autorità diretta e allineando le diverse parti interessate, tra cui consiglieri, proprietari, partner e team interfunzionali.
• Exhibited leadership credibile e influente, combinando la gestione del marchio imprenditoriale con la governance a livello aziendale, sostenuta da giudizio sano, forte capacità di negoziazione e il processo decisionale basato sul fatto.
• Costruite, guidate e sviluppate squadre ad alto rendimento all'interno di modelli organizzativi magre, dimostrando la capacità di priorizzare, risolvere i problemi, e fornire risultati in ambienti veloci, complessi e ambigui.
• Dimostrata forte governance, rischio e capacità di conformità, operante con alta integrità e responsabilità in ambienti multi-giurisdizionali e trasformazione leader, mantenendo la stabilità operativa.
• Creati rapporti di fiducia e stakeholder allineati a livello globale, combinando eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e partnership con una mentalità globale e uno stile di leadership orientato allo scopo allineato ai valori di benessere, resilienza e responsabilità personale.
• Laurea preferita, come MBA o equivalente Competenze chiave
• Curioso: aperto a nuove idee, cerca diversi punti di vista, ed esplora migliori modi di lavorare.
• Courageous: Sfida le norme, prende la proprietà e conduce il cambiamento.
• Connesso: Costruisce relazioni significative e favorisce la collaborazione attraverso i confini. Leadership aziendale e capacità di performance di picco
• Dimostra forte giudizio commerciale e acume finanziario, applicando la comprensione per guidare risultati sostenibili e il valore aziendale in un ambiente complesso, multi brand e multimarket.
• Funziona efficacemente in ambiguità, complessità e cambiamento, mantenendo la chiarezza di direzione e slancio, bilanciando le priorità concorrenti, gli impegni e gli orizzonti decisionali.
• Pensa e agisce con una mentalità aziendale, privilegiando i risultati finali all'ottimizzazione funzionale o locale e facendo compromessi disciplinati che proteggono l'integrità del marchio, soprattutto nel lusso, ottimizzando il valore aziendale.
• Imposta una chiara direzione strategica e traduce la visione in priorità, impegni e risultati misurabili attraverso gli altri, attraverso un'organizzazione altamente matrice e geograficamente dispersa.
• Costruisce partnership di stakeholder forti e basate sulla fiducia tra leader regionali senior, proprietari e partner di franchising, leadership alberghiera, piattaforme di brand e lusso e team di disciplina; influenze senza autorità e allinea interessi diversi e a volte concorrenti verso i risultati aziendali condivisi.
• Conduce in modo inclusivo in diverse culture, geografie e prospettive, dimostrando una forte fluenza culturale e una consapevolezza situazioniale, rafforzando allo stesso tempo scopi, valori e standard comuni.
• Crea le condizioni per prestazioni elevate sostenute, mantenendo elevati standard di responsabilità, consentendo al contempo focus, allineamento e miglioramento continuo su scala. Approccio di leadership e aspettative
• Conduce attraverso la visione e i valori, assicurando decisioni e comportamenti riflettono costantemente lo scopo organizzativo, gli standard del marchio e le aspettative di leadership aziendale.
• Guida come allenatore, adottando una mentalità di coaching che costruisce capacità, rafforza il giudizio e moltiplica l'impatto su team, mercati e gruppi di stakeholder.
• Incorpora continuamente, in tempo reale coaching e feedback, supportando individui e team per adattarsi, imparare e svolgere al meglio in ambienti complessi e in evoluzione.
• Guida e sostiene il cambiamento, modellando la resilienza, la compostezza e la fiducia, eliminando le barriere e accelerando il progresso attraverso più geografie e sistemi di stakeholder.
• Riguarda il giudizio sonoro e il processo decisionale a livello aziendale, integrando più prospettive, dati e intuizioni contestuali per navigare nella complessità e fare trading-off efficaci.
• Fornisce risultati attraverso gli altri, fissando chiare aspettative, stabilendo responsabilità individuale e collettiva, e assicurandosi di seguire attraverso un modello operativo matrixed.
• Investisce attivamente nel talento e nella successione, sviluppando leader attuali e futuri in grado di operare in scala e rappresentare l'impresa attraverso marchi e mercati. Contributo a Peak Performance
• I campioni di un coaching hanno condotto la cultura delle prestazioni, dove la fiducia, l'apprendimento e il dialogo onesto consentono prestazioni sostenute in team, marchi e geografie diverse.
• Collega i contributi individuali e di squadra a priorità e risultati aziendali, rafforzando la proprietà, la responsabilità e la chiarezza di scopo in un ambiente operativo complesso.
• Rafforza la capacità organizzativa scalando l'impatto attraverso le persone, consentendo ai leader e alle squadre di eseguire efficacemente senza affidamento sull'eroica personale.
• Forma una cultura del miglioramento continuo, della resilienza e dell'esecuzione disciplinata, assicurando all'impresa risultati coerenti, proteggendo l'integrità del marchio, soprattutto all'interno del lusso e incontrando gli impegni nei mercati. Marriott International è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nell'assunzione di una forza lavoro diversificata e nel sostenere una cultura inclusiva e primitiva. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, come la disabilità e lo status di veterano, o qualsiasi altra base coperta dalla legge applicabile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Job Summary The Global Managing Director – Lefay Wellness Resorts provides strategic and enterprise leadership for the long-term stewardship, evolution, and global expansion of Lefay, a luxury wellness resort brand. This role is accountable for safeguarding the brand’s founding philosophy and proprietary wellness methodologies while driving sustainable growth, financial performance, and asset value creation through a disciplined, asset-light model. Operating within a Joint Venture structure, the Managing Director partners closely with the Founders, Joint Venture Board, and Marriott’s global and regional functions to ensure the brand’s standards, operating model, and development pipeline are scalable, compliant, and aligned across markets. The role requires strong governance, stakeholder alignment, and the ability to lead effectively within a complex, matrixed organization. Leveraging a deliberately lean organizational model, the Managing Director provides leadership and strategic oversight across properties, including influence over General Manager selection and performance, while ensuring alignment to Lefay’s luxury positioning, wellness credibility, and guest experience standards. The position reports to the JV Board. Scope
• Location: Switzerland
• This position will be required to travel frequently Key Responsibilities
• Protect and scale Lefay’s wellness philosophy and proprietary methodologies by codifying and embedding the brand’s integrated wellness framework, encompassing its scientific underpinnings, treatment methodologies, programme design, and translation into consistent guest experiences across diverse global markets.
• Partner with ownership and development teams to grow a disciplined global pipeline by identifying and evaluating target markets and opportunities, encompassing feasibility assessment, deal structuring support, and alignment of all new developments to Lefay’s brand positioning, design philosophy, and financial performance expectations.
• Drive alignment across Marriott, the Joint Venture Board, owners, and brand stakeholders by establishing and leading governance and decision-making frameworks, encompassing structured forums, clear roles and accountabilities, and consistent communication to enable prioritisation and execution within a complex matrixed environment.
• Oversee brand standards, guest experience, and wellness programming globally by defining and governing Lefay’s end-to-end brand framework, encompassing brand pillars and foundational elements, tone of voice and positioning, and the full guest journey from pre-arrival through post-stay engagement.
• Serve as the primary interface with the Joint Venture Board of Directors by leading strategic engagement and performance reporting, encompassing regular updates on financial performance, development pipeline progress, brand evolution, and alignment on long-term strategic priorities.
• Lead governance processes including strategy, budgeting, and reporting by establishing and maintaining enterprise planning and performance frameworks, encompassing annual and long-range strategic plans, budget and forecasting cycles, and disciplined reporting against agreed KPIs and investment objectives
• Embed compliance with Marriott policies and regulatory frameworks by integrating required standards and controls into the operating model, encompassing oversight across all properties and developments, adherence to legal and governance requirements, and proactive identification and mitigation of risk across jurisdictions.
• Own full P&L accountability including forecasting and capital planning by driving financial performance across the portfolio, encompassing revenue and profitability optimisation, budget development and reforecasting, and capital allocation decisions aligned to long-term asset value creation.
• Optimize a lean Joint Venture operating model by leveraging Marriott’s global and regional infrastructure, encompassing clear delineation of responsibilities across shared services, efficient resource allocation, and avoidance of unnecessary above-property duplication.
• Oversee design, technical standards, and sustainability integration by guiding concept development and execution across the portfolio, encompassing alignment to Lefay’s aesthetic and wellness positioning, technical and operational standards, and the integration of sustainability principles into both development and ongoing operations.
• Lead global stakeholder engagement with owners, developers, and partners by building and maintaining strategic relationships, encompassing alignment on brand expectations, performance outcomes, and long-term growth opportunities across the Lefay portfolio.
• Build and lead a high-performing leadership team across functions by defining required capabilities and structure, encompassing talent selection and development across brand, design, and finance, and embedding a culture aligned to Lefay’s values, standards, and performance expectations.
• Lead through influence within a complex matrix organisation by aligning cross-functional Marriott teams across regions and disciplines, encompassing collaboration, prioritisation, and delivery of shared objectives without direct line authority.
• Sustain strong relationships to drive long-term brand and financial performance by engaging consistently with owners, Joint Venture partners, and internal stakeholders, encompassing alignment to strategic priorities, investment objectives, and sustained brand integrity over time. Additional Duties
• Uphold the highest standards of business ethics and compliance with Marriott policies.
• Champion cross-functional collaboration and team excellence, building a purpose-driven, peak performance culture across EMEA hotels and offices. Candidate Profile Required
• 15+ years of senior leadership experience within upper‑luxury hospitality, lifestyle, or wellness‑adjacent brands, ideally in resort environments.
• Demonstrated credibility in the wellness space, paired with the judgment to operate as an enterprise business leader rather than a functional specialist.
• Proven success leading complex, multi‑entity or Joint Venture structures with Board‑level accountability.
• Extensive experience operating in multicultural, matrixed, and internationally regulated environments, including Europe.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate market and business trends and translate strategy into large‑scale execution
• College degree required Preferred
• Demonstrated strong strategic and commercial leadership, balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and bringing deep financial acumen across P&L ownership, budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning.
• Operated effectively within complex, matrixed and Joint Venture environments, influencing outcomes without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders including Boards, owners, partners, and cross-functional teams.
• Exhibited credible and influential leadership, combining entrepreneurial brand stewardship with enterprise-level governance, supported by sound judgment, strong negotiation capability, and fact-based decision making.
• Built, led, and developed high-performing teams within lean organisational models, demonstrating the ability to prioritise, problem-solve, and deliver results in fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous environments.
• Demonstrated strong governance, risk, and compliance capability, operating with high integrity and accountability across multi-jurisdictional environments and leading transformation while maintaining operational stability.
• Built trusted relationships and aligned stakeholders globally, combining exceptional communication and partnership capability with a global mindset and a purpose-driven leadership style aligned to wellness values, resilience, and personal accountability.
• Graduate degree preferred, such as MBA or equivalent Key Competencies
• Curious : Open to new ideas, seeks diverse viewpoints, and explores better ways of working.
• Courageous : Challenges norms, takes ownership, and leads change.
• Connected : Builds meaningful relationships and fosters collaboration across boundaries. Enterprise Leadership & Peak Performance Capabilities
• Demonstrates strong commercial judgement and financial acumen, applying insight to drive sustainable results and enterprise value across a complex, multi brand and multimarket environment.
• Operates effectively in ambiguity, complexity, and change, maintaining clarity of direction and momentum while balancing competing priorities, commitments, and decision horizons.
• Thinks and acts with an enterprise mindset, prioritising end to end outcomes over functional or local optimisation and making disciplined trade-offs that protect brand integrity—particularly within luxury—while optimising enterprise value.
• Sets clear strategic direction and translates vision into priorities, commitments, and measurable outcomes through others, across a highly matrixed and geographically dispersed organisation.
• Builds strong, trust based stakeholder partnerships across senior regional leaders, owners and franchise partners, hotel leadership, brand and luxury platforms, and discipline teams; influences without authority and aligns diverse and sometimes competing interests toward shared enterprise outcomes.
• Leads inclusively across diverse cultures, geographies, and perspectives, demonstrating strong cultural fluency and situational awareness while reinforcing common purpose, values, and standards.
• Creates the conditions for sustained high performance, holding high standards of accountability while enabling focus, alignment, and continuous improvement at scale. Leadership Approach & Expectations
• Leads through vision and values, ensuring decisions and behaviours consistently reflect organisational purpose, brand standards, and enterprise leadership expectations.
• Leads as a coach, adopting a coaching mindset that builds capability, strengthens judgement, and multiplies impact across teams, markets, and stakeholder groups.
• Embeds continuous, real time coaching and feedback, supporting individuals and teams to adapt, learn, and perform at their best in complex and evolving environments.
• Drives and sustains change, modelling resilience, composure, and confidence while removing barriers and accelerating progress across multiple geographies and stakeholder systems.
• Applies sound judgement and enterprise level decision making, integrating multiple perspectives, data, and contextual insight to navigate complexity and make effective trade-offs.
• Delivers results through others, setting clear expectations, establishing individual and collective accountability, and ensuring follow through across a matrixed operating model.
• Invests actively in talent and succession, developing current and future leaders capable of operating at scale and representing the enterprise across brands and markets. Contribution to Peak Performance
• Champions a coaching led performance culture, where trust, learning, and honest dialogue enable sustained performance across diverse teams, brands, and geographies.
• Connects individual and team contributions to enterprise priorities and outcomes, reinforcing ownership, accountability, and clarity of purpose in a complex operating environment.
• Strengthens organisational capability by scaling impact through people, enabling leaders and teams to perform effectively without reliance on personal heroics.
• Shapes a culture of continuous improvement, resilience, and disciplined execution, ensuring the enterprise delivers consistent results while protecting brand integrity—particularly within luxury—and meeting commitments across markets. Marriott International is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Stellenbeschreibung Der Global Managing Director – Lefay Wellness Resorts bietet strategische und unternehmerische Führung für die langfristige Verwaltung, Entwicklung und globale Expansion von Lefay, einer Luxus-Wellness-Resort-Marke. Diese Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, die Gründungsphilosophie und die proprietären Wellness-Methoden der Marke zu wahren und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum, finanzielle Leistung und Wertschöpfung durch ein diszipliniertes Asset-Light-Modell zu fördern. Im Rahmen einer Joint-Venture-Struktur arbeitet der Managing Director eng mit den Gründern, dem Joint Venture Board und den globalen und regionalen Funktionen von Marriott zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Standards, das Betriebsmodell und die Entwicklungspipeline der Marke skalierbar, konform und marktübergreifend sind. Die Rolle erfordert eine starke Governance, die Ausrichtung der Stakeholder und die Fähigkeit, innerhalb einer komplexen, matrixförmigen Organisation effektiv zu führen. Durch die Nutzung eines bewusst schlanken Organisationsmodells bietet der Managing Director Führung und strategische Aufsicht über alle Immobilien, einschließlich des Einflusses auf die Auswahl und Leistung des General Managers, und gewährleistet gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung auf die Luxuspositionierung, die Glaubwürdigkeit des Wohlbefindens und die Standards für das Gästeerlebnis von Lefay. Der Standpunkt ist dem Verwaltungsrat des JV unterstellt. Anwendungsbereich
• Standort: Schweiz
• Diese Position wird benötigt, um häufig zu reisen
• Direkte Berichte: TBD Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Schützen und skalieren Sie Lefays Wellnessphilosophie und proprietäre Methoden, indem Sie das integrierte Wellness-Framework der Marke kodifizieren und einbetten, das seine wissenschaftlichen Grundlagen, Behandlungsmethoden, Programmdesign und Übersetzung in konsistente Gästeerlebnisse in verschiedenen globalen Märkten umfasst.
• Partnerschaft mit Eigentümer- und Entwicklungsteams, um eine disziplinierte globale Pipeline zu entwickeln, indem Zielmärkte und -chancen identifiziert und bewertet werden, einschließlich Machbarkeitsbewertung, Vertragsstrukturierung und Ausrichtung aller neuen Entwicklungen auf Lefays Markenpositionierung, Designphilosophie und finanzielle Leistungserwartungen.
• Förderung der Abstimmung zwischen Marriott, dem Joint Venture Board, Eigentümern und Markenstakeholdern durch die Einrichtung und Führung von Governance- und Entscheidungsrahmen, die strukturierte Foren, klare Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten sowie eine konsistente Kommunikation umfassen, um Priorisierung und Ausführung in einer komplexen matrixförmigen Umgebung zu ermöglichen.
• Überwachen Sie Markenstandards, Gästeerfahrung und Wellness-Programme weltweit, indem Sie das End-to-End-Marken-Framework von Lefay definieren und regeln, das Markensäulen und grundlegende Elemente, den Tonfall und die Positionierung sowie die gesamte Gästereise von der Ankunft vor dem Aufenthalt bis zum Engagement nach dem Aufenthalt umfasst.
• Dienen Sie als primäre Schnittstelle zum Board of Directors des Joint Ventures, indem Sie strategisches Engagement und Performance-Reporting leiten, das regelmäßige Updates zur finanziellen Performance, zum Fortschritt der Entwicklungspipeline, zur Markenentwicklung und zur Ausrichtung auf langfristige strategische Prioritäten umfasst.
• Lead-Governance-Prozesse einschließlich Strategie, Budgetierung und Berichterstattung durch Einrichtung und Aufrechterhaltung von Rahmenbedingungen für Unternehmensplanung und -leistung, einschließlich jährlicher und langfristiger strategischer Pläne, Budget- und Prognosezyklen sowie disziplinierte Berichterstattung nach vereinbarten KPIs und Anlagezielen
• Einbetten der Einhaltung der Marriott-Richtlinien und regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen durch die Integration der erforderlichen Standards und Kontrollen in das Betriebsmodell, einschließlich der Aufsicht über alle Eigenschaften und Entwicklungen, der Einhaltung der rechtlichen und Governance-Anforderungen sowie der proaktiven Identifizierung und Risikominderung in allen Rechtsordnungen.
• Eigene vollständige P&L-Rechenschaftspflicht einschließlich Prognose und Kapitalplanung durch Steigerung der finanziellen Performance im gesamten Portfolio, einschließlich Umsatz- und Rentabilitätsoptimierung, Budgetentwicklung und Reforecasting sowie Kapitalallokationsentscheidungen, die auf die langfristige Wertschöpfung ausgerichtet sind.
• Optimieren Sie ein schlankes Joint-Venture-Betriebsmodell durch die Nutzung der globalen und regionalen Infrastruktur von Marriott, die eine klare Abgrenzung der Verantwortlichkeiten für gemeinsame Dienste, eine effiziente Ressourcenallokation und die Vermeidung unnötiger Über-Eigentums-Duplizierungen umfasst.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie Design, technische Standards und Nachhaltigkeitsintegration, indem Sie die Konzeptentwicklung und -ausführung im gesamten Portfolio leiten, einschließlich der Ausrichtung auf die ästhetische und Wellness-Positionierung von Lefay, technische und operative Standards und die Integration von Nachhaltigkeitsprinzipien in die Entwicklung und den laufenden Betrieb.
• Führen Sie die globale Interaktion von Stakeholdern mit Eigentümern, Entwicklern und Partnern, indem Sie strategische Beziehungen aufbauen und pflegen, die die Ausrichtung auf Markenerwartungen, Leistungsergebnisse und langfristige Wachstumschancen im gesamten Lefay-Portfolio umfassen.
• Aufbau und Führung eines leistungsstarken Führungsteams für alle Funktionen, indem die erforderlichen Fähigkeiten und Strukturen definiert werden, die Auswahl und Entwicklung von Talenten für Marke, Design und Finanzen umfasst und eine Kultur integriert wird, die auf die Werte, Standards und Leistungserwartungen von Lefay ausgerichtet ist.
• Führen Sie durch Einfluss innerhalb einer komplexen Matrixorganisation durch die Ausrichtung funktionsübergreifender Marriott-Teams über Regionen und Disziplinen hinweg, einschließlich Zusammenarbeit, Priorisierung und Umsetzung gemeinsamer Ziele ohne direkte Leitungskompetenz.
• Pflegen Sie starke Beziehungen, um die langfristige Marken- und Finanzperformance zu fördern, indem Sie konsequent mit Eigentümern, Joint-Venture-Partnern und internen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, was die Ausrichtung auf strategische Prioritäten, Anlageziele und nachhaltige Markenintegrität im Laufe der Zeit umfasst. Zusätzliche Zölle
• Halten Sie die höchsten Standards der Geschäftsethik und die Einhaltung der Marriott-Richtlinien ein.
• Champion funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und Teamexzellenz, Aufbau einer zielgerichteten, Spitzenleistungskultur in EMEA Hotels und Büros. Bewerberprofil erforderlich
• 15+ Jahre Führungserfahrung in den Bereichen Gastgewerbe, Lifestyle oder Wellness-angrenzende Marken, idealerweise in Resort-Umgebungen.
• Demonstrierte Glaubwürdigkeit im Wellnessbereich, gepaart mit dem Urteil, als Unternehmensführer und nicht als funktionaler Spezialist zu agieren.
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Führung komplexer, mehrerer Unternehmen oder Joint Venture-Strukturen mit Rechenschaftspflicht auf Vorstandsebene.
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in multikulturellen, matrixförmigen und international regulierten Umgebungen, einschließlich Europa.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Markt- und Geschäftstrends zu bewerten und Strategie in eine groß angelegte Umsetzung umzusetzen
• College-Abschluss erforderlich Bevorzugt
• Demonstrierte starke strategische und kaufmännische Führungsrolle, balancierte langfristige Vision mit disziplinierter Ausführung und brachte tiefen finanziellen Scharfsinn über P & L Eigentum, Budgetierung, Prognose und Kapitalplanung.
• Funktioniert effektiv in komplexen, matrixförmigen und Joint-Venture-Umgebungen, beeinflusst Ergebnisse ohne direkte Autorität und richtet verschiedene Stakeholder aus, darunter Boards, Eigentümer, Partner und funktionsübergreifende Teams.
• Zeigte glaubwürdige und einflussreiche Führung, die unternehmerische Markenführung mit Unternehmensführung kombiniert, unterstützt durch fundiertes Urteilsvermögen, starke Verhandlungsfähigkeit und faktenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung.
• Aufbau, Leitung und Entwicklung leistungsstarker Teams innerhalb schlanker Organisationsmodelle, die die Fähigkeit demonstrieren, in schnelllebigen, komplexen und mehrdeutigen Umgebungen Prioritäten zu setzen, Probleme zu lösen und Ergebnisse zu liefern.
• Nachgewiesene starke Governance-, Risiko- und Compliance-Fähigkeit, mit hoher Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht in multi-jurisdiktionalen Umgebungen und führender Transformation bei gleichzeitiger Aufrechterhaltung der operativen Stabilität.
• Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen und global ausgerichteter Stakeholder, die außergewöhnliche Kommunikations- und Partnerschaftsfähigkeit mit einer globalen Denkweise und einem zielgerichteten Führungsstil kombinieren, der auf Wellnesswerte, Resilienz und persönliche Verantwortlichkeit ausgerichtet ist.
• Graduate Degree bevorzugt, wie MBA oder gleichwertig Schlüsselkompetenzen
• Neugierig: Offen für neue Ideen, sucht nach unterschiedlichen Standpunkten und erforscht bessere Arbeitsweisen.
• Mutig: Fordert Normen heraus, übernimmt Verantwortung und führt zu Veränderungen.
• Connected: Baut sinnvolle Beziehungen auf und fördert die Zusammenarbeit über Grenzen hinweg. Enterprise Leadership & Peak Performance Fähigkeiten
• Zeigt ein starkes wirtschaftliches Urteilsvermögen und finanziellen Scharfsinn und wendet Erkenntnisse an, um nachhaltige Ergebnisse und den Unternehmenswert in einem komplexen Multi-Marken- und Multi-Markt-Umfeld zu steigern.
• Funktioniert effektiv in Mehrdeutigkeit, Komplexität und Veränderung, behält die Klarheit der Richtung und des Momentums bei und balanciert konkurrierende Prioritäten, Verpflichtungen und Entscheidungshorizonte.
• Denkt und handelt mit einer Unternehmensmentalität, priorisiert End-to-End-Ergebnisse gegenüber funktionaler oder lokaler Optimierung und macht disziplinierte Kompromisse, die die Markenintegrität schützen - insbesondere im Luxusbereich - und gleichzeitig den Unternehmenswert optimieren.
• Legt eine klare strategische Richtung fest und übersetzt Vision in Prioritäten, Verpflichtungen und messbare Ergebnisse durch andere, in einer stark matrixisierten und geografisch verteilten Organisation.
• Aufbau starker, vertrauensvoller Stakeholder-Partnerschaften zwischen leitenden regionalen Führungskräften, Eigentümern und Franchise-Partnern, Hotelführung, Marken- und Luxusplattformen und Disziplinierungsteams; Einflüsse ohne Autorität und richtet verschiedene und manchmal konkurrierende Interessen auf gemeinsame Unternehmensergebnisse aus.
• Führt inklusiv über verschiedene Kulturen, Regionen und Perspektiven hinweg und zeigt eine starke kulturelle Flüssigkeit und ein Situationsbewusstsein, während gemeinsame Ziele, Werte und Standards gestärkt werden.
• Schafft die Bedingungen für eine nachhaltig hohe Leistung, hält hohe Standards der Rechenschaftspflicht und ermöglicht gleichzeitig Fokussierung, Ausrichtung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in großem Maßstab. Führungsansatz & Erwartungen
• Führt durch Vision und Werte und stellt sicher, dass Entscheidungen und Verhaltensweisen konsistent den organisatorischen Zweck, die Markenstandards und die Erwartungen der Unternehmensführung widerspiegeln.
• Führt als Coach und übernimmt eine Coaching-Mentalität, die Fähigkeiten aufbaut, das Urteilsvermögen stärkt und die Auswirkungen auf Teams, Märkte und Stakeholdergruppen vervielfacht.
• Bettet kontinuierliches Coaching und Feedback in Echtzeit ein und unterstützt Einzelpersonen und Teams dabei, sich in komplexen und sich entwickelnden Umgebungen anzupassen, zu lernen und ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen.
• Fördert und unterstützt Veränderungen, Modellierung von Widerstandsfähigkeit, Gelassenheit und Vertrauen, während Barrieren beseitigt und der Fortschritt in mehreren Regionen und Stakeholder-Systemen beschleunigt wird.
• Wendet fundiertes Urteilsvermögen und Entscheidungsfindung auf Unternehmensebene an und integriert mehrere Perspektiven, Daten und kontextbezogene Erkenntnisse, um Komplexität zu steuern und effektive Kompromisse zu erzielen.
• Liefert Ergebnisse durch andere, setzt klare Erwartungen, etabliert individuelle und kollektive Rechenschaftspflicht und stellt sicher, dass ein matrixförmiges Betriebsmodell eingehalten wird.
• Investiert aktiv in Talente und Nachfolge, entwickelt aktuelle und zukünftige Führungskräfte, die in der Lage sind, in großem Maßstab zu agieren und das Unternehmen marken- und marktübergreifend zu vertreten. Beitrag zur Peak Performance
• Verfechtet eine Coaching-geführte Leistungskultur, in der Vertrauen, Lernen und ehrlicher Dialog nachhaltige Leistung in verschiedenen Teams, Marken und Regionen ermöglichen.
• Verbindet Einzel- und Teambeiträge mit Unternehmensprioritäten und -ergebnissen und stärkt die Eigenverantwortung, Verantwortlichkeit und Zweckklarheit in einer komplexen Betriebsumgebung.
• Stärkung der organisatorischen Fähigkeiten durch Skalierung der Auswirkungen durch Menschen, so dass Führungskräfte und Teams effektiv arbeiten können, ohne auf persönliche Heldentaten angewiesen zu sein.
• Eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, Resilienz und disziplinierten Umsetzung, die sicherstellt, dass das Unternehmen konsistente Ergebnisse liefert und gleichzeitig die Markenintegrität - insbesondere im Luxusbereich - schützt und Verpflichtungen auf allen Märkten erfüllt. Marriott International ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Einstellung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und die Aufrechterhaltung einer integrativen, People-First-Kultur. Wir verpflichten uns zur Nichtdiskriminierung auf jeder geschützten Grundlage, wie z. B. Behinderung und Veteranenstatus, oder auf jeder anderen Grundlage, die unter geltendes Recht fällt.

Résumé de l'emploi Le Directeur Général – Lefay Wellness Resorts assure le leadership stratégique et d'entreprise pour l'intendance à long terme, l'évolution et l'expansion mondiale de Lefay, une marque de bien-être de luxe. Ce rôle est responsable de la sauvegarde de la philosophie fondatrice de la marque et des méthodologies de bien-être propriétaires tout en favorisant la croissance durable, la performance financière et la création de valeur d'actifs grâce à un modèle discipliné et léger. Dans le cadre d'une structure de coentreprise, le directeur général s'associe étroitement aux fonctions mondiales et régionales des fondateurs, du Conseil de coentreprise et de Marriott pour s'assurer que les normes de la marque, le modèle d'exploitation et le pipeline de développement sont évolutifs, conformes et alignés sur les marchés. Le rôle exige une gouvernance solide, l'harmonisation des intervenants et la capacité de diriger efficacement au sein d'une organisation complexe et matricielle. Tirant parti d'un modèle organisationnel délibérément allégé, le directeur général assure le leadership et la surveillance stratégique dans toutes les propriétés, y compris l'influence sur la sélection et le rendement des directeurs généraux, tout en assurant l'alignement sur les normes de positionnement de luxe, de crédibilité en matière de bien-être et d'expérience des clients. Le poste relève du conseil de la JV. Portée
• Lieu: Suisse
• Ce poste sera nécessaire pour voyager fréquemment
• Rapports directs : À déterminer Principales responsabilités
• Protéger et mettre à l'échelle la philosophie du bien-être et les méthodologies propriétaires de Lefay en codifiant et en intégrant le cadre de bien-être intégré de la marque, englobant ses fondements scientifiques, les méthodologies de traitement, la conception de programme et la traduction en expériences clients cohérentes sur divers marchés mondiaux.
• Partenaire avec des équipes de propriété et de développement pour développer un pipeline mondial discipliné en identifiant et en évaluant les marchés cibles et les opportunités, incluant l'évaluation de faisabilité, le soutien structurant des transactions et l'alignement de tous les nouveaux développements sur le positionnement de la marque Lefay, la philosophie de conception et les attentes en matière de performance financière.
• Favoriser l'alignement entre Marriott, le Joint Venture Board, les propriétaires et les parties prenantes de la marque en établissant et en dirigeant des cadres de gouvernance et de prise de décision, comprenant des forums structurés, des rôles clairs et des responsabilités, et une communication cohérente pour permettre la hiérarchisation et l'exécution dans un environnement matricielle complexe.
• Surveiller les normes de marque, l'expérience des clients et la programmation de bien-être à l'échelle mondiale en définissant et en dirigeant le cadre de marque de bout en bout de Lefay, qui englobe des piliers de marque et des éléments fondamentaux, le ton de la voix et du positionnement, et le parcours complet des clients, du pré-arrivée à l'engagement après le séjour.
• Servir d'interface principale avec le Conseil d'administration de Joint Venture en dirigeant l'engagement stratégique et l'établissement de rapports sur le rendement, y compris des mises à jour régulières sur le rendement financier, les progrès du pipeline de développement, l'évolution de la marque et l'alignement sur les priorités stratégiques à long terme.
• Diriger les processus de gouvernance, y compris la stratégie, la budgétisation et l'établissement de rapports, en établissant et en tenant à jour des cadres de planification des activités et d'exécution, comprenant des plans stratégiques annuels et à long terme, des cycles budgétaires et des cycles de prévision, et des rapports disciplinés par rapport aux indicateurs de performance et aux objectifs d'investissement convenus
• Intégrer la conformité aux politiques et aux cadres réglementaires de Marriott en intégrant les normes et les contrôles requis dans le modèle opérationnel, y compris la surveillance de tous les biens et de tous les développements, le respect des exigences juridiques et de gouvernance, et l'identification proactive et l'atténuation des risques entre les administrations.
• Sa propre responsabilité en matière de P&L, y compris la prévision et la planification des immobilisations, en stimulant la performance financière dans l'ensemble du portefeuille, englobant l'optimisation des recettes et de la rentabilité, l'élaboration et la prévision du budget et les décisions d'allocation des immobilisations alignées sur la création de valeur d'actifs à long terme.
• Optimiser le modèle d'exploitation de la coentreprise en tirant parti de l'infrastructure mondiale et régionale de Marriott, en définissant clairement les responsabilités à l'égard des services partagés, en répartissant efficacement les ressources et en évitant les doubles emplois inutiles.
• Superviser la conception, les normes techniques et l'intégration de la durabilité en guidant l'élaboration et l'exécution de concepts dans l'ensemble du portefeuille, incluant l'alignement sur le positionnement esthétique et bien-être de Lefay, les normes techniques et opérationnelles, et l'intégration des principes de durabilité dans le développement et les opérations en cours.
• Diriger l'engagement des intervenants à l'échelle mondiale auprès des propriétaires, des promoteurs et des partenaires en établissant et en maintenant des relations stratégiques, ce qui englobe l'alignement sur les attentes des marques, les résultats en matière de rendement et les possibilités de croissance à long terme dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de Lefay.
• Bâtir et diriger une équipe de leadership hautement performante dans toutes les fonctions en définissant les capacités et la structure requises, en incluant la sélection et le développement des talents dans toutes les marques, conception et finances, et en intégrant une culture alignée sur les valeurs, les normes et les attentes en matière de rendement de Lefay.
• Diriger par l'influence au sein d'une organisation matricielle complexe en alignant les équipes interfonctionnelles de Marriott entre les régions et les disciplines, englobant la collaboration, la hiérarchisation et la réalisation d'objectifs communs sans autorité directe.
• Maintenir des relations solides pour stimuler le rendement à long terme en matière de marques et de finances en collaborant de façon uniforme avec les propriétaires, les partenaires de la coentreprise et les intervenants internes, ce qui englobe l'harmonisation avec les priorités stratégiques, les objectifs d'investissement et l'intégrité soutenue de la marque au fil du temps. Fonctions supplémentaires
• Maintenir les normes les plus élevées en matière d'éthique des affaires et de conformité aux politiques de Marriott.
• Championne la collaboration interfonctionnelle et l'excellence de l'équipe, en construisant une culture de performance de pointe axée sur l'objectif dans tous les hôtels et bureaux de l'EMEA. Profil du candidat Requis
• Plus de 15 ans d'expérience en leadership chez des marques d'hospitalité, de style de vie ou de bien-être de luxe supérieure, idéalement dans les centres de villégiature.
• La crédibilité démontrée dans l'espace de bien-être, jumelée au jugement d'opérer comme chef d'entreprise plutôt qu'un spécialiste fonctionnel.
• Succès prouvé menant des structures complexes, multientités ou coentreprises avec une responsabilisation au niveau du conseil.
• Expérience étendue dans des environnements multiculturels, matriciaux et réglementés au niveau international, y compris en Europe.
• Capacité démontrée d'évaluer les tendances du marché et des affaires et de traduire la stratégie en exécution à grande échelle
• Diplôme requis Préféré
• Il a fait preuve d'un solide leadership stratégique et commercial, en conciliant la vision à long terme avec l'exécution disciplinée et en apportant un profond attrait financier à l'égard de la propriété, de la budgétisation, des prévisions et de la planification des immobilisations.
• Fonctionne efficacement dans des environnements complexes, matriciaux et de coentreprise, influençant les résultats sans autorisation directe et alignant divers intervenants, dont les conseils d'administration, les propriétaires, les partenaires et les équipes interfonctionnelles.
• Un leadership crédible et influent a été démontré, combinant l'intendance de la marque entrepreneuriale et la gouvernance au niveau de l'entreprise, appuyé par un jugement solide, une forte capacité de négociation et une prise de décision fondée sur les faits.
• Construit, dirigé et développé des équipes performantes au sein de modèles organisationnels maigres, démontrant la capacité de prioriser, résoudre les problèmes et produire des résultats dans des environnements rapides, complexes et ambigus.
• Démontré une solide capacité de gouvernance, de risque et de conformité, fonctionnant avec une intégrité et une responsabilisation élevées dans des environnements multigouvernementaux et menant une transformation tout en maintenant la stabilité opérationnelle.
• Établir des relations de confiance et harmoniser les intervenants à l'échelle mondiale, en combinant une capacité exceptionnelle de communication et de partenariat avec un état d'esprit mondial et un style de leadership axé sur l'objectif aligné sur les valeurs de bien-être, la résilience et la responsabilité personnelle.
• Diplôme d'études supérieures préféré, comme MBA ou équivalent Compétences clés
• Curieux : Ouvert aux nouvelles idées, cherche des points de vue divers et explore de meilleures façons de travailler.
• Courageux : Défis normes, prise en main, et conduit le changement.
• Connecté : Établit des relations significatives et favorise la collaboration au-delà des frontières. Leadership d'entreprise et capacités de performance de pointe
• Démontrer un jugement commercial fort et un sens financier, en appliquant la perspicacité pour stimuler des résultats durables et la valeur de l'entreprise dans un environnement complexe, multimarque et multimarché.
• Fonctionne efficacement dans l'ambiguïté, la complexité et le changement, en maintenant la clarté de l'orientation et de l'élan tout en conciliant les priorités, les engagements et les horizons décisionnels concurrents.
• Pense et agit avec un esprit d'entreprise, en donnant la priorité à la fin des résultats plutôt qu'à l'optimisation fonctionnelle ou locale et en faisant des compromis disciplinés qui protègent l'intégrité de la marque, notamment dans le luxe, tout en optimisant la valeur de l'entreprise.
• Établir une orientation stratégique claire et traduire la vision en priorités, en engagements et en résultats mesurables par d'autres, dans une organisation hautement matricielle et géographiquement dispersée.
• Bâtir des partenariats solides et fondés sur la confiance entre les principaux dirigeants régionaux, les propriétaires et les partenaires de franchise, le leadership hôtelier, les plateformes de marque et de luxe et les équipes de discipline; exercer des influences sans autorité et aligner des intérêts divers et parfois concurrents sur des résultats d'entreprise partagés.
• Dirige l'ensemble des cultures, des géographies et des points de vue variés, ce qui démontre une forte aisance culturelle et une prise de conscience de la situation tout en renforçant les buts, les valeurs et les normes communs.
• Créer les conditions d'un rendement élevé soutenu, maintenir des normes élevées de responsabilité tout en permettant l'orientation, l'alignement et l'amélioration continue à l'échelle. Approche et attentes en matière de leadership
• Diriger par la vision et les valeurs, en veillant à ce que les décisions et les comportements reflètent systématiquement l'objectif organisationnel, les normes de marque et les attentes en matière de leadership d'entreprise.
• Dirige en tant qu'entraîneur, en adoptant une mentalité de coaching qui renforce la capacité, renforce le jugement et multiplie l'impact entre les équipes, les marchés et les groupes d'intervenants.
• Embed continu, en temps réel coaching et feedback, aider les individus et les équipes à s'adapter, apprendre et effectuer à leur meilleur dans des environnements complexes et en évolution.
• Conduire et soutenir le changement, modéliser la résilience, le calme et la confiance tout en éliminant les obstacles et en accélérant les progrès dans de multiples géographies et systèmes d'intervenants.
• Applique un jugement judicieux et la prise de décisions au niveau de l'entreprise, en intégrant de multiples perspectives, données et perspectives contextuelles pour naviguer dans la complexité et faire des compromis efficaces.
• Résultats obtenus par d'autres, établissement d'attentes claires, établissement de la responsabilité individuelle et collective et mise en oeuvre d'un modèle d'exploitation matricielle.
• Investit activement dans le talent et la succession, développant les leaders actuels et futurs capables d'opérer à l'échelle et représentant l'entreprise à travers les marques et les marchés. Contribution à la performance maximale
• Champions d'une culture de performance axée sur le coaching, où la confiance, l'apprentissage et le dialogue honnête permettent des performances soutenues dans diverses équipes, marques et géographies.
• Relier les contributions individuelles et collectives aux priorités et aux résultats de l'entreprise, en renforçant l'appropriation, la responsabilisation et la clarté des objectifs dans un environnement opérationnel complexe.
• Renforcer la capacité organisationnelle en augmentant l'impact par le biais des personnes, en permettant aux dirigeants et aux équipes de se comporter efficacement sans se fier à des héroïques personnels.
• Forme une culture d'amélioration continue, de résilience et d'exécution disciplinée, assurant à l'entreprise des résultats cohérents tout en protégeant l'intégrité de la marque – en particulier dans le luxe – et en respectant ses engagements sur tous les marchés. Marriott International est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en l'embauche d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et en le maintien d'une culture inclusive et axée sur les gens. Nous sommes attachés à la non-discrimination sur toute base protégée, comme le handicap et le statut d'ancien combattant, ou toute autre base couverte par la loi applicable.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

We are looking for a creative, proactive and team-spirited ½ Chef de Partie to join the kitchen team of our venues, where refined techniques meet bold, flavorful cuisine.

This is your chance to be part of a restaurant concept that comes alive , a space where culinary artistry, ambiance and lifestyle converge to deliver a premium, high-energy dining experience in the heart of the Swiss Alps.

YOUR ROLE

Assist the Chef de Partie and kitchen leadership in the service operations, from prep to plating.

Execute dishes with precision, creativity, and consistency according to 5-star culinary standards.

Contribute to the identity of the venues by embracing their concepts and unique storytelling.

Maintain strict hygiene and cleanliness standards in accordance with HACCP and internal procedures.

Be proactive in your approach, from anticipating needs in the kitchen to suggesting fresh ideas.

Collaborate closely with your teammates, demonstrating flexibility, professionalism, and team spirit in a fast-paced service environment.

PROFILE

You have a true passion for cooking and attention to detail, especially in a fine dining dinner setting.

You enjoy the rhythm and energy of evening service, and know how to stay sharp and inspired from start to finish.

You bring a positive, can-do attitude and value cleanliness, organization, and collaboration.

You’re eager to grow within a creative and supportive team under the iconic W brand.

If you’re ready to light up the night with flavor, flair, and finesse, we want to hear from you.

Bring your creativity to the kitchen. Be the taste. Be the experience. Be W.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it: DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB Diventa un talento W e incarna l'arte W di vivere! Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione. UNA OPPORTUNITÀ ESEPIZIONALE PER IL TEAM VERBIER W! Siamo alla ricerca di un creativo, proattivo e team-spirited 1⁄2 Chef de Partie per unirsi al team di cucina delle nostre sedi, dove le tecniche raffinate incontrano cucina audace e saporita. Questa è la tua occasione per far parte di un concetto di ristorante che si anima, uno spazio in cui l'arte culinaria, l'atmosfera e lo stile di vita convergono per offrire un'esperienza culinaria premium e ad alta energia nel cuore delle Alpi svizzere. Il tuo! Assistere lo Chef de Partie e la leadership di cucina nelle operazioni di servizio, dalla preparazione alla placcatura. Eseguire piatti con precisione, creatività e consistenza secondo gli standard culinari a 5 stelle. Contribuisci all'identità dei luoghi abbracciando i loro concetti e la narrazione unica. Mantenere rigidi standard di igiene e pulizia in conformità con HACCP e procedure interne. Sii proattivo nel tuo approccio, dall'anticipazione delle esigenze in cucina a suggerire idee fresche. Collabora a stretto contatto con i tuoi compagni di squadra, dimostrando flessibilità, professionalità e spirito di squadra in un ambiente di servizio veloce. PROFESSIONALE Hai una vera passione per la cucina e l'attenzione ai dettagli, soprattutto in un ambiente di cena raffinata. Vi piace il ritmo e l'energia del servizio serale, e sapere come rimanere affilato e ispirato dall'inizio alla fine. Porti un atteggiamento positivo, can-do e la pulizia del valore, l'organizzazione e la collaborazione. Sei desideroso di crescere all'interno di un team creativo e di supporto sotto l'iconico marchio W. Se siete pronti a illuminare la notte con gusto, eleganza e finezza, vogliamo sentire da voi. Porta la tua creatività in cucina. Sii il gusto. Sii l'esperienza. Sii W. Posizione da riempire per la stagione invernale: da dicembre 2026 a marzo 2027 A causa delle restrizioni di visto solo i candidati provenienti dalla Svizzera e dall'Unione Europea possono essere considerati. A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

descriptionByLocale.de: BESCHREIBUNG Werde ein W Talent und verkörpere die W Art of Living! Als „Talent sind Sie die Essenz von W für unsere Gäste. Sie bringen eine spielerische, warme und einladende Note, die den Unterschied in unseren W Hotels macht. Du bist einzigartig, leidenschaftlich und deine Persönlichkeit scheint in jeder Interaktion durch. EINE AUSSERGEWÖHNLICHE Gelegenheit, am W VERBIER-TEAM teilzunehmen! Wir suchen einen kreativen, proaktiven und teambegeisterten 1⁄2 Chef de Partie, der sich dem Küchenteam unserer Veranstaltungsorte anschließt, wo raffinierte Techniken auf kühne, geschmackvolle Küche treffen. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Teil eines Restaurantkonzepts zu sein, das lebendig wird, ein Raum, in dem kulinarische Kunst, Ambiente und Lifestyle zusammenkommen, um ein erstklassiges, energiegeladenes kulinarisches Erlebnis im Herzen der Schweizer Alpen zu bieten. IHRE ROLLE Unterstützen Sie den Chef de Partie und die Küchenleitung bei den Servicevorgängen, von der Vorbereitung bis zur Beschichtung. Führen Sie Gerichte mit Präzision, Kreativität und Konsistenz nach kulinarischen 5-Sterne-Standards aus. Tragen Sie zur Identität der Veranstaltungsorte bei, indem Sie ihre Konzepte und ihr einzigartiges Storytelling annehmen. Einhaltung strenger Hygiene- und Sauberkeitsstandards gemäß HACCP und internen Verfahren. Seien Sie proaktiv in Ihrem Ansatz, von der Erwartung von Bedürfnissen in der Küche bis hin zu neuen Ideen. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihren Teamkollegen zusammen und zeigen Sie Flexibilität, Professionalität und Teamgeist in einer schnelllebigen Serviceumgebung. PROFIL Sie haben eine wahre Leidenschaft für Kochen und Liebe zum Detail, besonders in einem feinen Abendessen. PROFIL Vous avez une véritable passion pour la cuisine et l'attention au détail, en particulier dans un cadre gastronomique. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d'expériences de nos associés. Un esprit à la hauteur de tout est à notre cœur et nous a rendus réputés pour avoir réinventé les normes du luxe à travers le monde. Quoi qu'il en soit, notre philosophie de la culture et du service apporte à nos hôtes des passions. jobs.title: DJette (Winter 26/27) - W VERBIER
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

S he will be DJ // Contest

We are launching an online contest SHE WILL BE DJ//SHE MUST BE DJ for emerging talent to join the W Verbier. With ONE available spot, aspiring DJettes will compete for the chance to become Resident DJette at W Verbier for the ski season 2026/2027, jetting off to Verbier, Switzerland in December 2026.

You will be heating up the dance floor for the hottest destination in the Swiss Alps and be center stage at the OFFPISTE Après-Ski and at Living Room. You will participate to develop energy-infused music styling for W VERBIER and be ready to set the beat 5 days/5 nights per week – from après ski to beyond ++

You are Djette or your dream is to be Djette. You have performed in various witty places and you are ready to deliver top-notch beats for high-end clientele. Passionate about the dancing + music scene, you are witty and bold. An afternoon and nocturnal soul, creative, in the know, always in the flow, mixing/ mingling/dancing AND loving it.

Get ready to join the team. You will relocate to Verbier, Switzerland.

PROFILE
 The contest

DJettes must submit a minimum of 1 original track/video for the chance to win a spot in the W Verbier SHE WILL BE DJ//SHE MUST BE contest. 3 finalists will be notified of their success via email and invited to the finals taking place in one of the hottest place in Switzerland. Contest only reserved for Djettes.

• You have a background in the music field
 • You have experience mixing music in clubs and hotels
 • You are Fluent in French or English
 • Passion for Fashion Music Design and Fuel
 • Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.
