jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

As part of our team, you will take orders and serve guests in a cheerful, enthusiastic, professional and meticulous manner.

As an In-Room-Dining (Room-Service) Chef de Rang, you will join our afternoon/evening team . You will be responsible for taking orders to guests, preparing table settings, returning finished meals, as well as checking room mixbars. You will work nights to help ensure a quality service at all times of the day.

You will ensure that orders are ready on time and respond to the various requests of your Talent Coach.

PROFILE

Outgoing, cheerful, good listener, passionate and available.

Enjoys working at night

Fluent in French and English

Enjoy working in an international and adventurous team

Excellent presentation and representative of the W brand image

BAC PRO//CFC// BTS Restauration or 2 years in a similar position

You are highly motivated

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

You have great attention to detail and are passionate about delivering a memorable customer experience

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

 Description du poste :
 Nous recherchons un(e) Guest Service Expert passionné(e) par le service et l’expérience client afin de rejoindre notre équipe Food & Beverage.
 Nos métiers ne consistent pas simplement à servir des plats et des boissons. Nous voulons offrir à nos clients une expérience chaleureuse, fluide et mémorable. En tant que Guest Service Expert, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la satisfaction de nos clients en assurant un service attentif, professionnel et personnalisé.

• Accueillir et accompagner les clients avec professionnalisme et convivialité

• Assurer le service des boissons et des plats dans le respect des standards Marriott

• Communiquer efficacement avec la cuisine et les différentes équipes

• Une première expérience en restauration ou en hôtellerie est un plus

• Excellent sens du service client

• Présentation soignée et excellente communication

• Capacité à travailler en équipe dans un environnement dynamique

• Flexibilité horaire (week-ends et jours fériés inclus)

• Intégrer un groupe hôtelier international leader

• Opportunités d’évolution et de mobilité internationale

• Environnement de travail multiculturel et inclusif

• Formation continue et développement des compétences

jobs.title: B&F Intern (July - 6 months) - W VERBIER
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

To build up a strong experience in F&B operations, you will join our multi-skilled team as B&F Intern . You'll learn first-hand about hotel operations. Our hotel internship program allows you to experience the industry from the ground up

During your internship you will be in charge of :

- Ensure service standards

- Responsible for F&B service quality and customer satisfaction

- Ensure smooth collaboration between service and kitchen

- Help your team maintain the cleanliness of the various outlets and customer areas

- Help your team take and serve customer orders

- Collect orders and requisitions

- Welcoming and placing customers

- Ability to make appropriate recommendations based on customer preferences

- Ensure customer loyalty by offering friendly service

- Ensure smooth service and communication between kitchen and restaurant

- Ensure smooth flow of information between hotel departments

You will ensure that orders are ready on time and respond to the various requests of your Talent Coach.

PROFILE

- Must be currently enrolled in a Hospitality school

- Outgoing, playful, sociable, good listener, helpful and available

- Enjoy working in an international and audacious team

- Excellent presentation and representative of the W brand image

- You are highly motivated

- Excellent customer contact

- Fluency in foreign languages (English, German and others are an asset)

- Organized, conscientious, punctual

- Excellent knowledge of the hotel's various departments

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

You have great attention to detail and are passionate about delivering a memorable customer experience

Internship starting in June/July 2026 for 6 months

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

jobs.title: Apprenti(e) - Spécialiste en Restauration
jobs.description:
Serve food courses and alcoholic beverages to guests. Set tables according to type of event and service standards. Answer questions on menu selections. Communicate with the kitchen regarding menu questions, the length of wait, re-cook orders, and product availability. Communicate additional meal requirements, allergies, dietary needs, and special requests to the kitchen. Record transaction in MICROS system at time of order. Check in with guests to ensure satisfaction with each food course and/or beverages. Maintain cleanliness of work areas, china, glass, etc., throughout the day. Complete closing duties, including restocking items, turning off lights, etc. Present physical and accurate check to guest and process payment.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 50 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Build upon your classroom studies through our Hotel Internship Program opportunities. You will learn first-hand about a hotel's operations. You will get immersed in Marriott's culture and business and find your true calling in the travel industry. Our internships are typically available in many different areas of the hotel. Marriott International is the world�s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. We believe a great career is a journey of discovery and exploration. So, we ask, where will your journey take you?

marriotthotelinternship

Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
En tant que Coordinateur(trice) Événements & Groupes, vous êtes l'interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients pour l'organisation et le suivi de leurs événements. Vous assurez la coordination entre les équipes commerciales, opérationnelles et les clients afin de garantir une exécution fluide et une expérience exceptionnelle, de la confirmation de l'événement jusqu'au suivi après sa réalisation.

Vos principales missions

Gestion et coordination des événements

• Assurer la prise en charge et le suivi de toutes les demandes entrantes relatives aux groupes et événements corporate & sociales, via l'ensemble des canaux de communication.

• Coordonner l'ensemble des services de l'hôtel afin de garantir une parfaite exécution des événements.

• Gestion des réservations hébergements pour les groupes et intégration des roomings-lists

• Élaborer les propositions commerciales, devis et confirmations d'événements en collaboration avec les clients.

• Organiser et animer les réunions pré et post-événement avec les différents départements.

• Lire, analyser et préparer les dossiers événementiels ainsi que les Banquet Event Orders (BEO) afin de garantir la bonne compréhension des besoins clients.

• Déterminer les plannings de mise en place, les configurations des espaces, les besoins spécifiques des clients, les buffets, stations de service et autres exigences opérationnelles.

• Participer aux visites de site et présenter les installations aux clients lorsque nécessaire.

• Gestion de la facturation post-event & commissions

Relation client

• Être l'interlocuteur principal du client tout au long du processus (avant, pendant et après l'événement).

• Assurer une présence lors des événements afin de s'assurer que toutes les dispositions convenues sont respectées.

• Effectuer un suivi post-événement afin de mesurer la satisfaction client et identifier des pistes d'amélioration

Développement commercial

• Identifier des opportunités et proposer des services complémentaires adaptés aux besoins des clients.

• Générer des revenus additionnels à travers la valorisation des prestations de l'établissement.

• Contribuer à l'optimisation des revenus liés aux événements, aux chambres, à la restauration et aux prestations annexes.

• Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de l'établissement et des standards de marque.
 Profil recherché

• Formation et/ou expérience en hôtellerie, tourisme, événementiel, gestion ou domaine équivalent.

• Première expérience réussie dans l'organisation d'événements, la coordination de groupes, l'hôtellerie ou la gestion de projets clients.

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et sens aigu du détail.

• Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles et orientation client développée.

• Capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément dans un environnement dynamique.

• Excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale.

• Esprit d'équipe, flexibilité, attitude positive et sens du service.

• Capacité à anticiper, résoudre les problèmes et prendre des initiatives.

• Curiosité et volonté d'apprentissage continu.

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques et des logiciels hôteliers ou événementiels.

• Français et anglais courants indispensables ; toute autre langue constitue un avantage.
 Nous vous offrons

• Un environnement de travail stimulant et international.

• Des projets variés et des événements d'envergure.

• Une équipe collaborative et passionnée.

• Des opportunités de développement et d'évolution professionnelle.

• L'opportunité de contribuer directement à la satisfaction de nos clients et au succès de leurs événements.

Vous aimez orchestrer les détails qui font la différence, créer des expériences exceptionnelles pour vos clients et vous avez comme qualité la curiosité ? Rejoignez-nous et participez à la réussite de chaque événement.

In qualità di Coordinatore, Eventi e Gruppi, siete il contatto preferito dei nostri clienti per organizzare e monitorare i loro eventi. Garantisci un coordinamento tra team commerciali, operativi e clienti per garantire un'esecuzione regolare e un'esperienza eccezionale, dalla conferma dell'evento al follow-up dopo il completamento. Le vostre principali missioni Gestione e coordinamento degli eventi
• Supporta e segui tutte le richieste in arrivo per gruppi e eventi aziendali e sociali attraverso tutti i canali di comunicazione.
• Coordinate tutti i servizi dell'hotel per garantire una perfetta esecuzione degli eventi.

• Sviluppare proposte aziendali, stime e conferme di eventi in collaborazione con i clienti.

• Leggere, analizzare e preparare i file degli eventi e Banquet Event Orders (BEO) per garantire una buona comprensione delle esigenze del cliente.

jobs.title: Guest Experience Agent
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering exceptional guest experiences and creating memorable stays? Join our Front Office team as a Guest Experience Agent and become the first point of contact for our guests, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience from arrival to departure.
 Your Role
 As a Guest Experience Agent and Customer Care Coordinator, you will play a key role in delivering Marriott's service excellence standards by handling guest requests, managing front desk and telephone reception operations, coordinating with various hotel departments, and ensuring seamless communication through all guest contact channels. You will contribute to creating memorable guest experiences while ensuring complete guest satisfaction throughout their stay.
 Your Main Responsibilities Guest Services & At Your Service (AYS)

• Manage guest requests via phone, email, chat, and other communication channels.

• Answer and direct telephone calls according to Marriott standards.

• Coordinate guest requests with the relevant departments and ensure timely follow-up.

• Handle pre-arrival communications and guest profile updates.

• Process room service orders and assist guests with in-room services.

• Follow up on guest concerns and provide effective service recovery when needed.
 Guest Experience

• Anticipate guest needs and provide personalized service.

• Build meaningful connections with guests to enhance satisfaction and loyalty.

• Ensure all guest requests and concerns are resolved promptly and professionally.

• Deliver a high level of hospitality in line with Marriott brand standards.
 Teamwork & Communication

• Collaborate closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Engineering, and other departments to ensure a seamless guest experience.

• Support colleagues and contribute to a positive and collaborative team environment.

• Participate in daily operational communications, briefings, and handovers.

• Act as a key liaison between guests and operational departments, ensuring guest requests are communicated, followed up, and resolved efficiently.

• Work closely with the Front Desk team to support overall Front Office operations and service delivery.

• While this position is not a dedicated Front Desk Agent role, the associate may be required to support Front Desk activities based on operational needs. These tasks may include assisting with guest arrivals and departures, responding to guest inquiries, coordinating room readiness with Housekeeping, handling billing-related questions, and promoting Marriott Bonvoy enrolment and upselling opportunities.

• Maintain flexibility to support the Front Office team during busy periods while keeping the primary focus on guest request management, communication, coordination, and guest experience.

What We're Looking For Qualifications & Experience

• Previous experience in hospitality, customer service, front office, or guest relations preferred.

• Experience with Opera PMS is an asset.
 Skills

• Excellent customer service and communication skills.

• Professional telephone etiquette.

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.

• Ability to remain calm and solution-oriented under pressure.

• Positive attitude and team-player mindset.

• Good computer skills and attention to detail.
 Languages

• Fluent French and English required.

• Additional languages are highly valued.
 Why Join Marriott?
 At Marriott International, we believe our associates are our greatest asset. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can grow, develop their careers, and thrive.
 What we offer:

• International career opportunities within Marriott International

• Ongoing training and development

• A supportive and diverse work environment

• Associate benefits and hotel discounts worldwide

• The opportunity to be part of the world's leading hospitality company
 If you are passionate about people, service excellence, and creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.
 Apply now and start your Marriott journey with us.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of “Wonderful Hospitality. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that’s synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
 JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you’re happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand’s namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you’ll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That’s The JW Treatment™. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di offrire esperienze ospiti eccezionali e creare soggiorni memorabili? Unisciti al nostro team di Front Office come Guest Experience Agent e diventa il primo punto di contatto per i nostri ospiti, garantendo un'esperienza senza soluzione di continuità e personalizzata dall'arrivo alla partenza. Il tuo ruolo In qualità di Guest Experience Agent e Customer Care Coordinator, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella fornitura degli standard di eccellenza del servizio di Marriott attraverso la gestione delle richieste degli ospiti, la gestione delle operazioni di reception e di ricezione telefonica, il coordinamento con i vari dipartimenti dell'hotel e la garanzia di una comunicazione senza soluzione di continuità attraverso tutti i canali di contatto degli ospiti. Potrai contribuire a creare esperienze ospiti memorabili, assicurando la completa soddisfazione degli ospiti durante il loro soggiorno. I Servizi e i Servizi degli Ospiti di Responsabilità Principali (AYS)
• Gestisci le richieste degli ospiti tramite telefono, e-mail, chat e altri canali di comunicazione.
• Risposta e telefonate dirette secondo gli standard Marriott.
• Coordinare le richieste degli ospiti con i relativi dipartimenti e garantire il follow-up tempestivo.
• Gestisci comunicazioni pre-arrivo e aggiornamenti del profilo degli ospiti.
• Elaborare ordini di servizio in camera e assistere gli ospiti con servizi in camera.
• Seguire le preoccupazioni degli ospiti e fornire un efficace recupero di servizio quando necessario. Esperienza degli ospiti
• Anticipate esigenze degli ospiti e fornire un servizio personalizzato.
• Costruisci connessioni significative con gli ospiti per migliorare la soddisfazione e la fedeltà.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le richieste e le preoccupazioni degli ospiti siano risolte prontamente e professionalmente.
• Fornire un alto livello di ospitalità in linea con gli standard del marchio Marriott. Lavoro di squadra e comunicazione
• Collabora a stretto contatto con l'ufficio anteriore, la pulizia, il cibo e bevande, l'ingegneria e altri reparti per garantire un'esperienza ospiti senza soluzione di continuità.
• Sostenere i colleghi e contribuire a un ambiente di team positivo e collaborativo.
• Partecipa alle comunicazioni operative quotidiane, alle briefing e alle spedizioni.
• Agire come un collegamento chiave tra gli ospiti e i dipartimenti operativi, assicurando che le richieste degli ospiti siano comunicate, seguite e risolte in modo efficiente.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di Front Desk per supportare le operazioni generali di Front Office e la consegna dei servizi.
• Anche se questa posizione non è un ruolo di Front Desk Agent dedicato, il associato può essere richiesto per supportare le attività di Front Desk in base alle esigenze operative. Questi compiti possono includere l'assistenza con gli arrivi e le partenze degli ospiti, rispondendo alle richieste degli ospiti, coordinando la disponibilità delle camere con le pulizie, trattando domande relative alla fatturazione, e promuovendo l'iscrizione Marriott Bonvoy e le opportunità di upselling.
• Mantenere la flessibilità di supportare il team di Front Office durante i periodi di attività, mantenendo l'attenzione primaria sulla gestione delle richieste degli ospiti, la comunicazione, il coordinamento e l'esperienza degli ospiti. Cosa stiamo cercando per le qualifiche e l'esperienza
• Esperienza precedente in ospitalità, servizio clienti, ufficio anteriore, o relazioni ospiti preferito.
• L'esperienza con Opera PMS è una risorsa. Competenze
• Ottimo servizio clienti e capacità di comunicazione.
• Etichetta telefonica professionale.
• Forte capacità organizzative e multitasking.
• Capacità di rimanere calmo e orientato alla soluzione sotto pressione.
• L'atteggiamento positivo e la mentalità del giocatore di squadra.
• Buone competenze informatiche e attenzione ai dettagli. Lingue
• Francese fluente e inglese richiesto.
• Le lingue aggiuntive sono molto apprezzate. Perché iscriversi a Marriott? A Marriott International, crediamo che i nostri associati siano la nostra risorsa più grande. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo dove tutti possono crescere, sviluppare la loro carriera e prosperare. Cosa offriamo:
• Opportunità di carriera internazionali a Marriott International
• Formazione e sviluppo in corso
• Un ambiente di lavoro favorevole e diversificato
• Vantaggi associati e sconti alberghieri in tutto il mondo
• L'opportunità di far parte della principale azienda di ospitalità del mondo Se siete appassionati di persone, servizio di eccellenza, e la creazione di esperienze ospiti indimenticabili, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Applicare ora e iniziare il vostro viaggio Marriott con noi. A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. Marriott Hotels si sforza di elevare l'arte dell'ospitalità, innovando in ogni occasione mantenendo il comfort del oh-so-familiare in tutto il mondo. Come ospite di Marriott Hotels, vi aiuterà a mantenere la promessa di “ospitalità meravigliosa. Sempre.” fornendo un servizio pensieroso, sentito, in avanti che sostiene e costruisce su questa eredità vivente. Con il nome che è sinonimo di ospitalità in tutto il mondo, siamo orgogliosi di darvi il benvenuto per esplorare una carriera con Marriott Hotels. Entrando in Marriott Hotels, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi. JW Marriott fa parte del portafoglio di lusso di Marriott International e si compone di oltre 100 belle proprietà nelle città di gateway e località turistiche distintive in tutto il mondo. JW crede che i nostri associati vengano prima. Perché se sei felice, i nostri ospiti saranno felici. I soci JW Marriott sono fiduciosi, innovativi, genuini, intuitivi e portano avanti l’eredità dell’omonimo marchio e del fondatore della società, J.Willard Marriott. I nostri hotel offrono un'esperienza di lavoro a differenza di qualsiasi altro, dove sarete parte di una comunità e godere di vera camaraderie con un gruppo diversificato di colleghi. JW crea opportunità di formazione, sviluppo, riconoscimento e, soprattutto, un luogo in cui è possibile perseguire le vostre passioni in un ambiente di lusso con un focus sul benessere olistico. Trattare gli ospiti eccezionalmente inizia con il modo in cui ci prendiamo cura dei nostri associati. Questo è il JW TreatmentTM. Nell'unione di JW Marriott, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, außergewöhnliche Gästeerlebnisse zu bieten und unvergessliche Aufenthalte zu schaffen? Treten Sie unserem Front Office-Team als Guest Experience Agent bei und werden Sie der erste Ansprechpartner für unsere Gäste, um ein nahtloses und personalisiertes Erlebnis von der Ankunft bis zur Abreise zu gewährleisten. Deine Rolle Als Guest Experience Agent und Customer Care Coordinator spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bereitstellung der Service-Exzellenz-Standards von Marriott, indem Sie Gästeanfragen bearbeiten, Rezeption und Telefonempfang verwalten, mit verschiedenen Hotelabteilungen koordinieren und eine nahtlose Kommunikation über alle Gastkontaktkanäle gewährleisten. Sie werden dazu beitragen, unvergessliche Gästeerlebnisse zu schaffen und gleichzeitig die vollständige Gästezufriedenheit während ihres gesamten Aufenthalts zu gewährleisten. Ihre Hauptverantwortung Gastservice & At Your Service (AYS)
• Verwalten Sie Gästeanfragen über Telefon, E-Mail, Chat und andere Kommunikationskanäle.
• Beantworten und direkte Telefongespräche nach Marriott-Standards.
• Koordinieren Sie die Gästeanfragen mit den zuständigen Abteilungen und sorgen Sie für eine rechtzeitige Nachverfolgung.
• Handle Pre-Arrival-Kommunikation und Gästeprofil-Updates.
• Bearbeiten Sie Zimmerservice-Bestellungen und unterstützen Sie die Gäste mit In-Zimmer-Services.
• Folgen Sie den Bedenken der Gäste und bieten Sie bei Bedarf eine effektive Servicewiederherstellung. Gästeerfahrung
• Antizipieren Sie die Bedürfnisse der Gäste und bieten Sie einen persönlichen Service.
• Bauen Sie sinnvolle Verbindungen mit Gästen auf, um Zufriedenheit und Loyalität zu verbessern.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Anfragen und Bedenken der Gäste umgehend und professionell gelöst werden.
• Liefern Sie ein hohes Maß an Gastfreundschaft gemäß den Markenstandards von Marriott. Teamwork & Kommunikation
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Engineering und anderen Abteilungen zusammen, um ein nahtloses Gästeerlebnis zu gewährleisten.
• Unterstützen Sie Kollegen und tragen Sie zu einem positiven und kollaborativen Teamumfeld bei.
• Nehmen Sie an der täglichen operativen Kommunikation, Briefings und Übergaben teil.
• Handeln Sie als eine wichtige Verbindung zwischen Gästen und operativen Abteilungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass Gästeanfragen effizient kommuniziert, verfolgt und gelöst werden.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Front Desk-Team zusammen, um den gesamten Front Office-Betrieb und die Servicebereitstellung zu unterstützen.
• Während diese Position keine dedizierte Front Desk Agent-Rolle ist, kann es erforderlich sein, dass der Partner Front Desk-Aktivitäten basierend auf operativen Anforderungen unterstützt. Diese Aufgaben können die Unterstützung bei der Ankunft und Abreise von Gästen, die Beantwortung von Gästeanfragen, die Koordination der Zimmerbereitschaft mit Housekeeping, die Bearbeitung von Fragen im Zusammenhang mit der Rechnungsstellung und die Förderung von Marriott Bonvoy-Einschreibungs- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten umfassen.
• Behalten Sie die Flexibilität bei, um das Front Office-Team in geschäftigen Zeiten zu unterstützen, während Sie sich in erster Linie auf das Management von Gästeanfragen, die Kommunikation, die Koordination und die Gästeerfahrung konzentrieren. Was wir suchen nach Qualifikationen und Erfahrung
• Frühere Erfahrungen in Gastfreundschaft, Kundenservice, Front Office oder Gastbeziehungen bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung mit Opera PMS ist ein Gewinn. Fähigkeiten
• Ausgezeichneter Kundenservice und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Professionelle Telefonetikette.
• Starke organisatorische und Multitasking Fähigkeiten.
• Fähigkeit, unter Druck ruhig und lösungsorientiert zu bleiben.
• Positive Einstellung und Teamplayer-Mentalität.
• Gute Computerkenntnisse und Liebe zum Detail. Sprachen
• Fließend Französisch und Englisch erforderlich.
• Zusätzliche Sprachen werden sehr geschätzt. Warum Marriott beitreten? Bei Marriott International glauben wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser größtes Kapital sind. Wir sind bestrebt, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder wachsen, seine Karriere entwickeln und gedeihen kann. Was wir anbieten:
• Internationale Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb von Marriott International
• Laufende Ausbildung und Entwicklung

jobs.title: Commis de Cuisine
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
 • Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 • Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

SUMMARIO POSIZIONE

Preparare gli ingredienti per cucinare, tra cui porzione, taglio e stoccaggio del cibo. Lavare e pelare frutta e verdura fresca. Pesare, misurare e mescolare gli ingredienti. Preparare e cucinare il cibo secondo ricette, standard di qualità, standard di presentazione e la lista di controllo di preparazione del cibo. Preparare cibi freddi. Lavorare forni, fornelli, griglie, microonde e friggitrici. Provare gli alimenti per determinare se sono stati cucinati abbastanza. Monitorare la qualità del cibo durante la preparazione del cibo. Impostare e abbattere la stazione di lavoro. Servire il cibo in porzioni adeguate su ricettacoli appropriati. Lavare e disinfettare zona cucina, tavoli, strumenti, coltelli e attrezzature. Controllare e garantire la correttezza della temperatura degli apparecchi e del cibo.

Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure aziendali e di sicurezza; segnalare esigenze di manutenzione, incidenti, infortuni e condizioni di lavoro non sicure al gestore; formazione completa e certificazioni di sicurezza. Assicurare l'aspetto uniforme e personale sono puliti e professionali; mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni proprietarie; proteggere le attività aziendali. Parla con gli altri usando linguaggio chiaro e professionale. Sviluppare e mantenere rapporti di lavoro positivi con gli altri; il team di supporto per raggiungere obiettivi comuni; ascoltare e rispondere adeguatamente alle preoccupazioni di altri dipendenti. Assicurare l'adesione a aspettative e standard di qualità. Stand, sit, o camminare per un lungo periodo di tempo o per un intero turno di lavoro. Raggiungere la testa sopra e sotto le ginocchia, tra cui piegatura, torsione, tirando e poggiando. Spostare, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 25 libbre senza assistenza. Eseguire altri ragionevoli compiti di lavoro come richiesto dai Supervisori.

QUALIFICAZIONE PREFERRATA
 • Istruzione: diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente G.E.D.
 • Esperienza di lavoro correlata: almeno 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa correlata.
 • Esperienza di supervisione: Nessuna esperienza di supervisione.
 • Licenza o Certificazione: Nessuno

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

In oltre 100 strutture premiate in tutto il mondo, The Ritz-Carlton Signore e Signori creano esperienze così eccezionali che a lungo dopo un ospite soggiorna con noi, l'esperienza rimane con loro. Attrarre i migliori professionisti dell’ospitalità del mondo che curano i ricordi per tutta la vita, crediamo che tutti ci riescano quando hanno il potere di essere creativi, riflessivi e compassionevoli.
Ogni giorno, abbiamo stabilito lo standard per il servizio di lusso raro e speciale in tutto il mondo e ci orgogliosi di fornire l'eccellenza nella cura e nel comfort dei nostri ospiti.

Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di garantire che i “Gold Standards” di The Ritz-Carlton vengano consegnati con gentilezza e con pensiero ogni giorno. ZUSAMMENFASSUNG DER POSITION

Bereiten Sie Zutaten für das Kochen, einschließlich Portionierung, Hacken und Lagerung von Lebensmitteln. Frisches Obst und Gemüse waschen und schälen. Wiegen, messen und mischen Sie Zutaten. Bereiten und kochen Sie Lebensmittel nach Rezepturen, Qualitätsstandards, Präsentationsstandards und Checkliste für die Zubereitung von Lebensmitteln. Bereiten Sie kalte Lebensmittel zu. Betrieb von Öfen, Öfen, Grills, Mikrowellen und Friteusen. Testen Sie Lebensmittel, um festzustellen, ob sie ausreichend gekocht wurden. Überwachen Sie die Lebensmittelqualität während der Zubereitung von Lebensmitteln. Einrichtung und Abbau von Arbeitsplätzen. Servieren Sie Essen in richtigen Portionen auf richtige Behälter. Waschen und Desinfizieren Sie Küchenbereich, Tische, Werkzeuge, Messer und Geräte. Überprüfen und gewährleisten Sie die Richtigkeit der Temperatur von Geräten und Lebensmitteln.

Befolgen sie alle unternehmens- und sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren; melden sie wartungsbedürfnisse, unfälle, verletzungen und unsichere arbeitsbedingungen an den manager; schließen sie sicherheitsschulungen und zertifizierungen ab. Stellen Sie sicher, dass ein einheitliches und persönliches Erscheinungsbild sauber und professionell ist; wahren Sie die Vertraulichkeit der proprietären Informationen; schützen Sie die Vermögenswerte des Unternehmens. Sprechen Sie mit anderen mit einer klaren und professionellen Sprache. Entwickeln und pflegen Sie positive Arbeitsbeziehungen zu anderen; unterstützen Sie das Team, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen; hören Sie zu und reagieren Sie angemessen auf die Anliegen anderer Mitarbeiter. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Qualitätserwartungen und Standards. Stehen, sitzen oder gehen für einen längeren Zeitraum oder für eine ganze Arbeitsschicht. Erreichen Sie über Kopf und unter den Knien, einschließlich Biegen, Verdrehen, Ziehen und Bücken. Bewegen, Heben, Tragen, Schieben, Ziehen und Platzieren von Objekten mit einem Gewicht von weniger als oder gleich 25 Pfund ohne Hilfe. Führen Sie andere angemessene Aufgaben aus, wie von den Aufsichtsbehörden verlangt.

RÉSUMÉ DE LA POSITION

Préparer les ingrédients pour la cuisson, y compris la portion, la découpe et le stockage des aliments. Lavez et épluchez les fruits et légumes frais. Peser, mesurer et mélanger les ingrédients. Préparer et cuire les aliments selon les recettes, les normes de qualité, les normes de présentation et la liste de contrôle de préparation des aliments. Préparez des aliments froids. Utiliser des fours, des cuisinières, des grillades, des micro-ondes et des friteuses. Tester les aliments pour déterminer s'ils ont été suffisamment cuits.
